Security with clear boundaries.

Inspectable controls, explicit limitations and an agreed process before any client information is introduced.

WHAT YOU CAN EVALUATE
Control and evidence.

The published local.5 plugin demonstrates signed exact-action and business-state binding, replay controls, optional shared approval and budget controls across processes on one machine, and separately signed synthetic destination evidence.

The destination rechecks approved state before a synthetic commit. Ambiguous outcomes retain UNKNOWN holds and require explicit reconciliation rather than automatic retry. A standalone public-key verifier can inspect destination evidence without writable ATG state or destination private-key access.

Inspect the plugin and reproduction guides →

Current limits
Synthetic. Same host. No production claim.

CLIENT INFORMATION
Start with fictional records.

The public website has no customer-data upload, hosted agent execution API or customer-account system.

Minimise the data

Initial evaluations use synthetic business records. Do not send customer records, personal information, production logs, source secrets, payment details or live credentials by email.

Agree the boundary

Any proposed client-data work needs a separately agreed data flow, permitted processors, access controls, key custody, retention and deletion responsibilities.

Review before deployment

A real deployment needs its own threat assessment, authenticated roles, partner enforcement, incident and recovery procedures, and independent security assessment appropriate to the scope.

Report a concern privately.

Agent Trust Gate™
EXACT ACTION TRUST GATEWAY
Challenge
Plugin
Technology

UNPUBLISHED LOCAL.6 CANDIDATE · PUBLISHED LOCAL.5 RETAINED
Install ATG in your agent project.

Use the existing exact-action authority core through a Node.js SDK or local MCP. Evaluate a proposed action, inspect its evidence and reproduce one-use gated execution in a synthetic workflow.

Inspect unpublished local.6 candidate
Published local.5 (unchanged)
Full integration guide

Local evaluation only. Synthetic authority and evidence, fixture signing keys and a fixed synthetic clock. Not production ready or customer validated. No live purchasing/payment connector or self-learning.

MISSION 04 · UNPUBLISHED CANDIDATE
Reviewed fixes, unchanged evaluation limits.

Local.6 includes the reviewed signing fix for own JSON fields previously omitted from legacy signed bytes, plus POSIX creation modes of 0700 for new durable JSON directories and 0600 for atomic temporary files. Changed signed fields now fail verification. Existing directories and held state are not repaired, reset or migrated.

Published local.5 does not contain these fixes. The local.6 candidate does not configure private Windows NTFS ACLs. Provision and inspect a private new parent separately, including temporary and replacement files. Local records are not encrypted by ATG; same-user and administrator access remain outside this boundary. Synthetic fixture authority, keys and clocks and same-host destination keys remain. No independent security assurance or production readiness is claimed.

Read Security & Trust

NODE.JS 20+ LEGACY · NODE 24+ SHARED WORKERS
Install into an existing project.

The local.6 candidate exists only in this local review checkout pending Gareth and Dave’s review. Use its exact local archive path from a fresh Node.js project; the local.6 website URL is not a live release. Published local.5 remains unchanged. Neither edition is published to the npm registry.

npm install C:\path\to\agent-trust-gate-plugin-0.1.0-local.6.tgz
npx --no-install atg-plugin --help
npx --no-install atg-plugin request

Candidate and historical SHA-256 manifest (draft) →

Reproduce before integrating.

The repository provides a build command and tests which install the actual archive in a fresh project, then exercise the SDK and MCP outside the repository working directory.

npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run plugin:pack
npm run test:plugin

Inspect source and tests →

ONE AUTHORITY CORE
Two ways to evaluate. One synthetic execution example.

Choose the integration route that fits your local evaluation. Installation alone does not enforce a real external action.

Node.js SDK

Submit the existing v2 business-policy request. Receive a decision and opaque session handle. Changed requests and edited returned decisions cannot create synthetic execution authority.

Local MCP

Start the stdio server with a host-selected absolute state path. Exactly one tool, atg.evaluate_action, is exposed. No execution or administration tool.

Gated synthetic example

Only an enforced ACCEPT can reach the built-in synthetic adapter. Shadow, referral, refusal, expiry and reuse are blocked. Decision and synthetic execution receipts remain separate and linked.

NEW IN 0.1.0-LOCAL.3 · SYNTHETIC PURCHASE-ORDER EVALUATION
Check the outcome as well as the approval.

Reproduce the approval-to-outcome flow in a controlled local destination before discussing a live business integration.

Approval carries signed state

The exact approved business-state snapshot is covered by the GatePass fixture signature. Order or supplier-bank version changes require fresh approval. The destination checks the signed state again at synthetic commit, including a change after preliminary verification.

Uncertainty holds execution

A lost acknowledgement produces UNKNOWN. Destination lookup establishes whether the local order was recorded. The old attempt cannot be retried automatically.

Compare request and outcome

Reconciliation verifies the original signed state binding against the destination record. Invalid recovery evidence retains UNKNOWN exposure. Linked decision, execution and destination records remain inspectable same-host evidence.

Explore the ATG Challenge.

Changed details, reused approval and lost acknowledgement: inspect the recorded results →

Run four reproducible scenarios.
npx --no-install atg-plugin order-demo --state /absolute/path/to/new-evaluation

Use a new host-owned directory per run. This fixture uses one synthetic order and same-host destination evidence. The approved state binding is included inside the canonical arguments covered by the existing GatePass signature. Approvals, keys and time are fixtures; the evidence is maintained on the same host and controls are single-process. No real ERP connector, independent execution capture or production guarantee is implemented.

Review behaviour, tests and recovery limits →
HOST-CONTROLLED EVALUATION
Keep authority explicit.
Use synthetic data; do not provide production credentials or customer data.
Keep the absolute state path outside the installed package.
Run one process per legacy state file. Optional shared-worker SQLite v2 supports processes on one machine; no multi-machine guarantee.
Session handles do not survive restart; lifecycle and exposure records do.
No automatic retry after uncertain execution.
Learning and execution verification

Learning remains possible future advisory work: anomaly detection and human-reviewed suggestions. It must not expand authority or rewrite enforcement.

External execution verification, including a possible Salmon connection, is exploratory. No integration or partnership is implemented.

TECHNICAL PARTNERS AND BUYER EVALUATIONS
Bring one bounded agent workflow.

A live partner adapter would need exact-action enforcement, bypass prevention, real authority records, trusted time, protected keys and external-effect reconciliation. The current package does not establish those production properties.

Discuss an evaluation →
Controlled pilot scope
NEW IN LOCAL.4 · NODE 24+
Inspect separate worker processes on one machine.

The optional shared-worker SDK and packaged demonstration use local SQLite transactions for approval claims and exposure, with synthetic destination fencing and reconciliation. Legacy SDK, CLI and evaluation-only MCP remain Node 20 compatible.

npx --no-install atg-multi-worker --state C:\ATG-Evaluation\fresh-shared-run-001

Use a new absolute host-owned directory with an existing parent. The command retains SQLite v2 state and results.json; it never removes or reuses existing state. Existing v1 shared directories fail closed: preserve them, do not reset or automatically migrate.

Seven coordinated process scenarios record write counts, reserved exposure and recovery outcomes. Budget observations are inspected before any write. Each scenario supports one synthetic order. Fixture authority, keys and fixed time, and same-host destination evidence do not establish independent execution capture, multi-machine distributed safety or production readiness.

Inspect recorded packaged evidence →
Shared-worker setup and recovery limits →

The existing three-case Challenge remains available with its local.3 recording.

NEW IN LOCAL.5 · VERIFIER NODE 20+ · DESTINATION NODE 24+
Verify separately signed destination evidence.

A separate synthetic destination process owns its records and generated evaluation signing key. ATG receives only an explicitly pinned public key. Approval and execution evidence stay distinct. Missing, tampered, stale or incomplete evidence retains UNKNOWN exposure; signed absence needs authoritative lookup and completed permanent fencing.

npx --no-install atg-destination-evidence --state C:\ATG-Evaluation\new-destination-run-001
npx --no-install atg-evidence-verify --help

Explicit fresh setup only: parent directory must exist and the run root must be new. Eight cases retain state and public verification inputs. Existing v1/v2 directories are never reset or automatically migrated. Legacy SDK/CLI/MCP and the standalone public verifier support Node 20; destination/shared-worker functionality requires Node 24.

One machine, same-host synthetic destination records, synthetic keys and fixed test clock. Separately signed roles do not establish independent external capture, host-administrator protection, live-time freshness, partner attestation or a live partner integration. No automatic execution retry or reauthorisation.

Inspect unpublished local.6 exact-archive observations
Published local.5 observations (unchanged)
Buyer guide and recovery limits

Retained prior downloads: local.2, local.3, local.4. The existing Challenge and local.4 worker recording remain available.

Agent Trust Gate™
EXACT ACTION TRUST GATEWAY

Local synthetic exact-action authority and evidence demonstrator. Production deployment is not claimed.
